decision.explanation: Both 'Wycombe Wanderers F.C.' and 'FC Dunărea Călărași' are directly supported by their respective documents. Document d1 explicitly states that Craig Dobson signed with Wycombe Wanderers F.C. and is part of the team. Document d2 describes Dobson as a member of FC Dunărea Călărași, including details of his integration into the team and wearing the club's jersey. These are distinct teams and valid representations, so both answers are retained.
